en: The postcard features a monochrome photograph on one side, showing a large clock tower (fire watchtower) and adjacent buildings along a waterfront or dock area. The landscape is rather industrial/rural, with several warehouses and wood planks visible. There is handwritten Swedish text over the image. The reverse side displays the address section, written in Swedish, with a green Swedish stamp (with a portrait, denomination 5 öre) and the printed word 'BREFKORT.' in Swedish, indicating it is a postcard format.
